title: Kiro Pet Supplies
description: Bulk-ordering platform that replaces a pet-supply wholesaler's paper notes and chat threads.
extendedDescription: A catalog and ordering platform built for a pet-supply wholesaler that used to run bulk orders through paper notes, phone calls and memory. Shop owners register their store locations, browse a price-free catalog, and submit an order that becomes a durable record from the first moment. The admin reviews each order, adjusts quantities and prices against real availability, and every change is logged as a discrete event, so there is always a clear audit trail of what was agreed. Finalised orders produce a PDF invoice that is sent to the customer over WhatsApp. The system is bilingual (English and Arabic), ships as installable PWAs for both customers and admins, and includes a Filament admin dashboard with spreadsheet import/export. This is a commercial product: the source code is not public, and installations are available on request.
